records.title: Fable III — castle-tested WIP installer 0.1.1
records.notes: Experimental Fable III Windows 10/11 x64 installer. Retains the exact opening-Castle-tested executable and matching runtime. Supply your own matching Xbox 360 ISO or extracted game files; original ISO/XEX, assets and saves are not included. The compiled native application and matching runtime are included. Walter training and the Castle exit remain unfinished; this is not a complete-game compatibility claim. Installer lifecycle checks do not establish new gameplay validation. Saves/settings remain separate from versioned application files. Runtime source and license materials: https://retroremakes.retroremakes.chatgpt.site/downloads/xbox-360/wip/runtime-source-v0-10-0-20261027.zip (SHA256 00885c9fb0ed9b44f736a6062ed082fc578f103b1849233c0325b9af7fb388b9).
